This image contains software from Debian GNU/Linux 12 (bookworm), including the GNU C/C++
compiler (gcc/g++ 12.2.0) and GNU binutils 2.40, Eigen 3.4.0, and the Debian base system.
Each package is distributed under its own license, recorded in /usr/share/doc/<package>/copyright.
The complete corresponding source code of every Debian package in this image, at the exact
versions installed, is available at no charge from:
  https://github.com/pineforge-4pass/pineforge-release/releases/tag/<this version>
(file SOURCES.list lists every package, version and SHA-256). The same packages can also be
obtained from https://snapshot.debian.org/ under the names and versions listed.
